---
name: "nf-core/fastq_align_dna"
description: "Align fastq files to a reference genome"
keywords:
- "fastq"
- "bam"
- "sort"
- "bwamem"
- "bwamem2"
- "bwamem3"
- "dragmap"
- "snapaligner"
- "strobealign"
components:
- "bowtie2/align"
- "bwa/mem"
- "bwamem2/mem"
- "bwamem3/mem"
- "dragmap/align"
- "snapaligner/align"
- "strobealign"
input:
- ch_reads:
    type: "file"
    description: "List of input FastQ files of size 1 and 2 for single-end and paired-end\
      \ data,\nrespectively.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), [ path(reads) ] ]\n"
- ch_aligner_index:
    type: "directory"
    description: "Directory containing the aligner genome index files.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta2), path(index) ]\n"
- ch_fasta:
    type: "file"
    description: "Reference genome in fasta format.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta3), path(fasta)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fa, fasta, fna}"
- aligner:
    type: "string"
    description: "Aligner to use for alignment"
    enum:
    - "bowtie2"
    - "bwa"
    - "bwamem2"
    - "dragmap"
    - "snap"
    - "strobealign"
- sort:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "sort output"
output:
- bam:
    type: "file"
    description: "BAM file.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(bam) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.bam"
- bam_index:
    type: "file"
    description: "BAM index (only produced by some aligners).\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(bai/csi) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{bai, csi}"
- reports:
    type: "file"
    description: "Alignment report (currently only for dragmap).\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(log) ]\n"
authors:
- "@matthdsm"
maintainers:
- "@matthdsm"
version: "0.0.0-5eae6c7"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/bowtie2/align@0.0.0-5eae6c7"
  - "nf-core/bwa/mem@0.0.0-5eae6c7"
  - "nf-core/bwamem2/mem@0.0.0-5eae6c7"
  - "nf-core/bwamem3/mem@0.0.0-5eae6c7"
  - "nf-core/dragmap/align@0.0.0-3c23b0c"
  - "nf-core/snapaligner/align@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/strobealign@0.0.0-6d1763b"
